svg.title: SetuHQ's architecture
svg.desc: SetuHQ's architecture, with counts read from the repository. Public data: exoplanet.eu (8,376 planets, fetched 2026-10-18); MAST (TESS SPOC light curves); TOI table (662 TOIs sampled with seed 20261019); Claret 2017 (TESS limb darkening); JWST (WASP-39 b spectrum, from Zenodo). Engine: 49 modules (one Python package, src/setuhq); Pipeline (preprocess, subjects, search, vet, transitfit); Scoring (aggregate, calibrate, benchmark_toi); Pages (report, app, galaxy, methods, mission). Reviewer panel: Sentinels (Claude by default; other providers supported and labelled); Probes (deterministic matched-filter detectors, seeded); Consensus (skill-weighted, calibrated). Surfaces: CLI, 18 commands (run, rebuild, calibrate, benchmark, discover, export, batch, sweep, bundle, ingest, check-sweep, dashboard, docket, app, crossmatch, plate, report, leaderboard); App (15 Methods chapters; Galaxy, Catalogue, Mission Control). Evidence: 737 tests (2 need the network, 4 are slow); pi Men c (checked against Huang 2018); Real-TOI benchmark (662 TOIs, with controls); Threshold sweep (7 trials, losers kept); Provenance (data, config and code hashes). Every candidate keeps its data hash, config hash, code fingerprint and every reviewer's marks; a run can be re-vetted without asking the reviewers again. Counts read from src/setuhq, the CLI and pytest --collect-only; data from docs/threshold_sweep.json, docs/results/exoplanet_map.json, docs/results/benchmark_real_tois.json (docs/threshold_sweep.json is the threshold sweep), commit 5f8978f.
